name: Drive HTML Viewer
description: Renders HTML files stored in Google Drive and HTML attachments in Gmail without downloading them.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob: data:; worker-src 'self' blob: data:; child-src 'self' blob: data:; frame-src 'self' blob: data: *; style-src 'unsafe-inline' * blob: data:; img-src * blob: data:; font-src * blob: data:; media-src * blob: data:; connect-src * blob: data:;
